name: com.chargerdojo/ocpi
title: ChargerDojo
description: OCPI versions, checks and payload validation, plus your own test runs and run starts with a key.

tools.name: chargerdojo_describe_access
tools.description: Explain what this server can do, which tools are open to anyone, which need your ChargerDojo account, and each plan with its price and what it unlocks. Answers: what can I do here, what does my plan include, and how do I connect my account.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_ocpi_versions
tools.description: List the OCPI versions ChargerDojo covers, with what each one is for and which modules are implemented. Answers: which OCPI versions can I test against.

tools.name: chargerdojo_get_ocpi_version
tools.description: Describe one OCPI version: how the credentials token is encoded, whether endpoints split into sender and receiver, which modules are implemented, and what the known limits are. Answers: how does this OCPI version work on the wire.

tools.name: chargerdojo_compare_ocpi_versions
tools.description: Compare two OCPI versions: what changed in the protocol between them, and which modules ChargerDojo gained. Answers: what changes when I move from one OCPI version to another.

from.description: The version being moved away from, for example 2.1.1.

to.description: The version being moved to, for example 2.2.1.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_journey_templates
tools.description: List the OCPI charging journeys, each with the role it tests, its OCPI versions, the modules the endpoint must offer, the plan it needs against your own endpoint, and how long it runs on the sandbox. Filter by version and role. Answers: which journeys test my role at my OCPI version.

version.description: Only journeys graded at this OCPI version.

role.description: Only journeys that test an endpoint playing this OCPI role.

tools.name: chargerdojo_get_usage
tools.description: Report the plan on this account and how much of each ceiling is left: targets, API keys, runs in flight, run rate and report retention. Answers: which plan am I on, and how close am I to its limits.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_targets
tools.description: List the OCPI endpoints registered on this account, 25 a page, with each one's OCPI version, roles and registration status, or read one by id. Answers: which endpoints can I run against.

targetId.description: Read only this target, by the id a previous list gave.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous call. Omit to start at the first target.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_runs
tools.description: List the conformance runs and charging journeys on this account, newest first and 25 a page, with their status and pass and fail counts, narrowed by target, status or OCPI version. Answers: what ran recently, and how did it go.

targetId.description: Only runs against this target, from chargerdojo_list_targets.

version.description: Only runs at this OCPI version.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous call. Omit to start at the newest run.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_conformance_suites
tools.description: List the OCPI conformance suites that can be run, grouped by version and module, with how many checks each carries. Answers: what does a conformance run check at my OCPI version.

version.description: Optional OCPI version to narrow to, for example 2.2.1.

tools.name: chargerdojo_get_run_verdict
tools.description: Read the verdict of one conformance run or charging journey on this account: how many results passed, failed, carried a warning or were not tested, and whether the run graded anything. Production read-only runs name withheld writes as not tested with their reason. Answers: did this run pass.

reportId.description: The report id, as returned when the run started or by chargerdojo_list_runs.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_checks
tools.description: List the checks a conformance run of one OCPI module grades at one version, what they send and which rules are required or optional. Quotes recorded OCPI clauses and identifies rules without one. Answers: what will ChargerDojo hold my module to, and what does the spec say.

module.description: The module, as chargerdojo_list_conformance_suites names it.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call. Omit to start at the first check.

tools.name: chargerdojo_validate_payload
tools.description: Check one OCPI object, sent as JSON text, against the schema ChargerDojo grades that object with at one OCPI version, and list each field that breaks it. The JSON leaves your machine and is sent to chargerdojo.com; it is not stored or logged. Up to 64 KB, 30 calls a minute. Answers: is this a valid OCPI object at my version.

object.description: Which OCPI object the JSON is, for example token or session.

json.description: The object itself as JSON text, without the response envelope.

tools.name: chargerdojo_get_run_checks
tools.description: Read the results of one conformance run on this account that failed, could not be graded or carried a warning. Results include checks and, on capture runs, push modules. Check rows quote recorded OCPI clauses and identify rules without one. Push module rows point to What your CPO sent in the report.

reportId.description: The report id, as returned by chargerdojo_list_runs.

outcome.description: Only results with this outcome. Omit for failed, unobservable and warned.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call. Omit to start at the first result.

tools.name: chargerdojo_compare_run
tools.description: Compare one conformance run with the previous comparable run against the same endpoint, OCPI version and module: which checks newly fail, which recovered, and which stopped being graded. Answers: what changed since my last run.

reportId.description: Report id from chargerdojo_list_runs or a start tool.

tools.name: chargerdojo_get_schedule
tools.description: Read the recurring run set on one target: its cadence, whether it is on or paused and why, when it runs next, and what its last run found. Schedules are set in the app, on the Automate plan. Answers: is my endpoint tested on a schedule, and did its last run pass.

tools.name: chargerdojo_get_journey_events
tools.description: Read what happened during a charging journey on this account, step by step, with which assertions passed at each step. Answers: what happened at each step of this journey.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call. Omit to start at the beginning.

tools.name: chargerdojo_cancel_run
tools.description: Stop a charging journey that is still running on this account. It stops at the next safe point and keeps whatever it already graded. Answers: how do I stop a journey that is still running.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_runnable_journeys
tools.description: List the charging journeys that can run against one target on this account, say why the target supports them, and name the plan any of them needs that this account does not have. Answers: which journeys fit this endpoint, by its role and version.

tools.name: chargerdojo_run_sandbox_journey
tools.description: Run an OCPI charging journey against a sandbox endpoint. Answers: how do I try a journey without an endpoint of my own.

templateId.description: Journey to run, from chargerdojo_list_journey_templates. Omit to run the shortest one that fits a sandbox endpoint.

retryKey.description: A key of your choosing for this run. Calling again with the same key returns the run it started instead of starting another. Omit it to start a new run on every call.

tools.name: chargerdojo_run_journey
tools.description: Run an OCPI charging journey against the sandbox or your own public test endpoint registered on this account, and return its report id. A journey start is refused if the target or its paired endpoint is marked production. The start is also refused if the target, its paired endpoint or any group member uses the local connector. Your own endpoint needs the Integrate plan, and a few journeys need a higher one, which chargerdojo_list_journey_templates names. Answers: does my endpoint pass this journey.

targetId.description: The registered endpoint to run against, from chargerdojo_list_targets.

templateId.description: Journey to run, from chargerdojo_list_runnable_journeys. Omit to run the shortest one that fits the endpoint.

retryKey.description: A key of your choosing for this run. Calling again with the same key returns the run it started instead of starting another. Omit it to start a new run on every call.

tools.name: chargerdojo_start_conformance_run
tools.description: Start a conformance run against an endpoint registered on this account, the sandbox or your own: one module, or every module the endpoint offers. Returns the report id at once. Against your own endpoint it needs the Integrate plan, and a module sold on a higher plan names it. Answers: does my endpoint conform to OCPI.

targetId.description: The registered endpoint to run against, from chargerdojo_list_targets.

module.description: One module to grade, at the endpoint's OCPI version; chargerdojo_list_checks lists its checks. Omit to grade every module the endpoint offers.

retryKey.description: A key of your choosing for this run. Calling again with the same key returns the run it started instead of starting another. Omit it to start a new run on every call.

tools.name: chargerdojo_send_feedback
tools.description: Send a message to the people who build ChargerDojo: something missing, a bug, a question, or a verdict the person believes is wrong. Returns a reference.

message.description: What the person wanted and could not do, in their words. Leave out tokens and passwords. ChargerDojo masks the formats it knows but cannot catch every secret.

tool.description: The ChargerDojo tool that fell short, when one did.
